subject: hungarian
summary: Hungarian is among the cleaner subjects here. Accented text (ő, ű) renders correctly, the questions are complete with the term in quotation marks, the right article is attached every time with no other questions on it, and the vocabulary schemes say which paragraph the phrase is in and give a mark. The essay card shows the four weighted criteria with a score picker for each. Faults: the 5-mark 'explain and give your opinion' schemes are either one 28-line paragraph worth all 5 marks or have their lead-in sentence and A/B/C lettering pushed into a grey English note; placeholder text from the scheme ('Igen, egyetértek ezzel, mert... vagy Nem, ... mert ....') is shown as if it were a point; and the grey language-rule note, here five lines long on a phone, sits under every answer.

issues.title: Scheme lead-in and A/B/C structure pushed into a grey note
issues.detail: Card 5's first tick box opens with a 14-line grey block (phone): the language rule, then 'The scheme leads its answer with “A szöveg 7. bekezdése alapján adott válasz: Dóka Péter azért állítja ... mert korszakhatárt jelölt:”, letters its three points A, B and C, then prints the last line shown here.' The actual points below it carry no A/B/C letters and no marks, so the description does not match what the student sees.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the lead-in as a normal heading line ('Based on paragraph 7: ... because it marked a turning point:'), then points A, B, C lettered, then 'Your opinion' as a separate row.

issues.title: One long paragraph worth all 5 marks
issues.detail: Card 1's scheme is a single box of about 28 lines on the phone with one 5m badge, combining the explanation from the text and the opinion placeholder. No partial credit is possible and it is a wall of text.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into the explanation ideas (no house/car, serves corporate profit, tax avoidance) and a separate 'own opinion with reason' row, with marks.

issues.title: Opinion placeholder shown as a scheme point
issues.detail: 'Igen, egyetértek ezzel, mert... vagy Nem, nem értek egyet, mert... vagy részben értek egyet, mert ....' (yes because... or no because... or partly because...) appears as a tick box on card 5 and at the end of card 1's paragraph, with trailing dot runs. It reads like unfinished text.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with a plain row: 'States own opinion (agree / disagree / partly) and gives a reason'.

issues.title: Grey language-rule note under every answer
issues.detail: 'The examination requires every answer in HUNGARIAN. The paper prints the rule on page 2: "Olvassa el a következő szöveget, és válaszoljon érthetően magyarul az I., II. és III. részben feltett kérdésekre!"' is five to six lines on a phone, longer than the 1-mark answers on cards 2 and 3.

issues.title: Essay title runs on from the instruction
issues.detail: Card 4: 'A két téma közül válasszon ki egyet, és írjon egy minimum 300 szavas esszét! A sokszínűség előnyei' puts the title straight after the instruction with no break, and says 'choose one of the two topics' while showing one.
issues.suggested_fix: Title on its own line in bold.

good_examples.why: Vocabulary card done well: the answer names the paragraph and gives the meaning in one sentence, 1 mark.
Essay criteria with weightings and a score picker per criterion.
Same clean vocabulary pattern, right text attached with the phrase in bold.
